title: 60 Minutes whistleblower told to 'turn down the temperature'
summary: Eric Hazeline tells of 60 Minutes whistleblower told to 'turn down the temperature', about recent at US government, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote:
>> But you saw in 60 minutes that guy who
said he quit said uh uh that woman came
to him and said, "We got to turn down
the temperature on this thing."

plain: Eric Hazeline, described as a former director of the NSA, the US signals intelligence agency, recalls a segment on 60 Minutes, an American television news programme. He says a man who had quit his government job told the show that a woman came to him and said they had to turn down the temperature on the UFO issue, which would suggest officials were trying to quiet the subject down.
